title: Volatility Forecasts with Market Trends
abstract: arXiv:2606.20145v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We show how volatility forecasts for financial markets can be refined by accounting for the current trends in these markets. Empirically, volatilities tend to increase day after day in times of strong up- or down-trends. This effect is particularly pronounced during down-trends. We find that it can accurately be modeled by including quadratic polynomials of the current trend strength as explanatory factors. Such factors can improve the predictive power of a wide range of volatility models, ranging from linear EWMA-based models over GARCH models and range-based models to stochastic volatility models. Our results are based on a robust statistical analysis of three decades of daily futures prices across equity-, bond-, FX- and commodity markets.

translated_title: 基于市场趋势的波动率预测
translated_abstract: 我们展示了如何通过考虑金融市场当前的趋势来改进波动率预测。实证表明，在强劲的上涨或下跌趋势期间，波动率往往日复一日地上升，且这种效应在下跌趋势中尤为显著。我们发现，将当前趋势强度的二次多项式作为解释性因子，可以对该效应进行准确建模。此类因子能够提升多种波动率模型的预测能力，涵盖从基于EWMA的线性模型、GARCH模型、基于价格区间的模型，到随机波动率模型。我们的结果基于对三十年间股票、债券、外汇及大宗商品市场每日期货价格的稳健统计分析。
tldr: 该论文发现将市场当前趋势强度的二次多项式作为解释因子纳入各类波动率模型（包括EWMA、GARCH、基于价格区间的模型和随机波动率模型），可显著提升金融市场波动率的预测能力，且该效应在下跌趋势中最为显著。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that incorporating quadratic polynomials of current market trend strength as explanatory factors significantly improves the predictive power of a wide range of volatility models (EWMA, GARCH, range-based, and stochastic volatility models), with the effect being most pronounced during downtrends.
